name: Cliky Bundle
description: The ultimate sensory collection. Includes high-fidelity Sunflower, Cheese, and Rotary tools.
whyToUse: The Bundle offers a versatile toolkit for diverse sensory needs. Having all three flagship tools allows children to find the exact tactile feedback they need for any home or school environment.
howToUse: Swap between the Sunflower, Cheese, and Rotary tools to prevent sensory habits.
Use the variety of textures and resistance levels to keep engagement high.
Rotate tools across different environments (one for school, one for car, one for home).

whenToUse.title: All-Day Support
whenToUse.description: Keep different tools in different rooms for constant regulatory support.

whenToUse.title: Therapy Success
whenToUse.description: Ideal for clinicians working with diverse sensory profiles.

specifications.Contents: Sunflower, Cheese, and Rotary Cliky tools
specifications.Suitability: Ideal for homes, classrooms, and therapy sessions
